messages:
Maya: Quick non-work question — what's your go-to comfort food after a long shipping day? I need ideas for tonight. I'll start: mac & cheese (extra crispy top). :cheese: 
Jordan: Ramen. Always ramen. Quick, slurpy, and you can add an egg. :ramen: 
Sam: Grilled cheese + tomato soup combo. Old reliable. Sometimes add avocado. :bread: :tomato: 
Alex: Curry — anything with coconut milk. Leftovers get better and better. Naan crisped in a pan is chef-tier. :curry: 
Pat: Cold pizza, hot coffee. Don’t @ me. :pizza: :coffee: 
Nina: Ice cream. Usually pints of something ridiculous (rocky road tonight maybe). Also great for stress-eating. :ice_cream: 
Leo: Homemade pho when I have the energy. Otherwise store-bought dumplings fried golden. :dumpling: 
Maya: Love the naan crisping hack — pan + butter + 30s. Mind blown the first time. 
Jordan: Also — what's the fastest comfort meal you can make at 9pm when you're exhausted? 
Sam: Microwave baked potato + butter + cheese + hot sauce. 10 minutes. 
Alex: Eggs. So many ways, minimal cleanup. Scrambled + sriracha. 
Pat: Toast with peanut butter and banana. Kids would be proud. :banana: 
Nina: Poll time? poll-bot: "What's your top comfort food?" Options: 1) Pizza, 2) Ramen, 3) Curry, 4) Dessert. Vote with reactions. 
poll-bot: Poll created (30m). React below: :one: Pizza, :two: Ramen, :three: Curry, :four: Dessert
Jordan: :two: (already voted)
Maya: :one: then :four: for dessert tie-breaker
Sam: :one:
Alex: :three:
Pat: :one: (cold pizza is underrated)
Nina: :four: (ice cream forever)
Leo: :two:
Maya: Thanks for the ideas — might attempt ramen or mac & cheese hybrid? Will report back with pics. :camera_with_flash:
